verdict.rationale: A state business and lien registry could plausibly publish a programmatic API with an OpenAPI spec, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only human-facing portal pages (search, filing, ordering), a login-based online account, and 'Data and Image Subscriptions' with no indication of an API or a downloadable machine-readable spec. Probes show the SOS front door and the DOR e-services behind Radware bot walls, and nothing in the pack points to an OpenAPI or equivalent document.
